title: As Anthropic prepares to IPO, Amazon and Google collectively own 25%+; Amazon's $18B investment could reach $250B+ in value and Google's $33B could hit $140B (Karen Weise/New York Times)
summary: Karen Weise / New York Times: As Anthropic prepares to IPO, Amazon and Google collectively own 25%+; Amazon's $18B investment could reach $250B+ in value and Google's $33B could hit $140B — Amazon and Google are the largest investors in the A.I. start-up, and their shares could gain hundreds of billions of dollars in value.
